primary.body:
## Description

This PR addresses **40+ bugs** across authentication, agent orchestration, task streaming, and Docker deployment. The changes improve security, reliability, and performance of the entire system.

## Related Issues

Closes multiple issues related to:
- Authentication token management failures
- Agent over-decomposition of simple tasks
- Task execution race conditions and failures
- SSE streaming reliability
- Docker provider configuration

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [x] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [x] Test addition/update

## Changes by Area
